users.short_bio:
An Nguyen is a third-year software engineering student who loves building Android apps. He started learning Java two years ago and now spends most of his weekends turning small ideas into working prototypes.
 Outside of coding, An enjoys specialty coffee, playing badminton with classmates, and contributing to open-source projects. His goal is to become a mobile developer at a product company.

Binh Tran is a UI and UX enthusiast who pays close attention to colors, spacing and typography.
 She often says "good design is invisible" and tests every screen on three different phones before sharing it. In her free time, Binh sketches interface ideas in a notebook and collects Material Design references.
Chi Le is a travel photographer who takes the camera on every weekend trip. He has visited more than twenty provinces and keeps a small online gallery of his favorite landscapes.
Dung Pham loves football and reads technology books on the bus every morning. She is the team captain of her university futsal club.
Em Vo is learning Java and wants to build a small expense tracker app for his family.
Phuong Hoang enjoys cooking new recipes and listening to indie music while she studies.
Quan Dang works well in a team and is always the first to help classmates debug their code.
Huong Bui reads novels in her spare time and is studying Japanese for her future internship.
Khoa Ly plays guitar in a student band and goes running every morning before class.
Lan Dinh is a data analysis fan who loves turning messy spreadsheets into clear charts.
